built.name: H1 — Domain-pair generalisation layer (sqlunet lexname priors + MetaNet conventionality penalty)
built.claim: Liveness verdicts that are hopelessly sparse at synset granularity (5/248 edge recurrence) DO recur at (topic_domain → vehicle_domain) granularity using the 45 imported sqlunet lexicographer domains (optionally collapsed to ~5-8 super-domains), so a back-off prior learned from graded edges can rank novel candidate pairs by domain-pair productivity. MetaNet's ~700 curated conceptual metaphors act as a conventionality PENALTY (membership in a canonical mapping like ARGUMENT IS WAR predicts dead), and novel pairs are instantiated within productive domain-pairs via concreteness/embedding filters.
built.relation_to_incumbent: COMPLEMENTS and partially subsumes metaphor-graph-completion: domain-pair priors are the natural back-off level of the completion hierarchy (synset-edge → lemma-edge → domain-pair → global base rate), i.e. hierarchical smoothing over the same explicit-edge layer. It supplies the generalisation rung the incumbent currently lacks (synset edges almost never recur), decides WHERE to spend candidate-generation budget (productive domain-pairs), and adds a conventionality penalty aligning the scorer with the live-metaphor product goal. It does NOT replace pair-level discrimination: within-cell flips (wound: 1 live/2 dead inside the single feeling→feeling cell) prove a domain prior cannot adjudicate individual pairs — path geometry (max_hop_cos) and the future judge stay the pair-level signal. Property-cascade remains demoted to cold-start feature-provider, untouched by this hypothesis.
built.mechanism: Data structures: (1) `domain_pair_priors(topic_domainid, vehicle_domainid, live_n, dead_n)` — a max 45x45 (collapsed ~8x8) table of Beta-smoothed liveness odds, rebuilt idempotently from resolved verdicts after each grading session (today: 85 joinable live+dead rows); (2) a committed, pre-registered super-domain collapse map (lexname → {NAT-physical, ARTIFACT, ACT/EVENT, ABSTRACT, VERB}-style buckets) so bucket choice is not fitted per-analysis; (3) `metanet_mappings(mapping, source_frame, target_frame)` ~700 static rows + a topic/vehicle→frame membership probe (offline, HQ-side LLM or manual for the ~260 topic universe) emitting a binary `conventional_mapping_member` penalty feature; (4) one-line `CREATE INDEX idx_synsets_domainid ON synsets(domainid)` (currently missing — full 107,519-row scan). Scoring: candidate (topic_synset, vehicle_synset) → join domainids (100% coverage, zero LLM) → features [log-odds(domain-pair LOTO prior), same-super-domain flag (synonymy/dead risk), MetaNet membership penalty] feeding the small supervised pairwise scorer (Bizzoni & Lappin regime, trains on hundreds of labels, CPU-seconds) alongside max_hop_cos geometry. Generation targeting: rank ungraded/un-generated topic-classes by prior productivity (e.g. feeling→natural-process/substance is hot: vinegar, brine, fermentation, calcification, undertow all live) before spending the $1.9k 10k run. LLMs sit ONLY offline/HQ (frame-membership tagging, candidate generation); school runtime is pure SQLite lookup of precomputed tables. Sense-fix prerequisite shared with geometry: the domain join inherits sense-snap errors (gloss audit found ~12/85 graded vehicles snapped to visibly wrong senses — jewel→person, aurora→dawn, heliotrope→bloodstone gem, music→'face the music', fault→sports serve, storm→military assault, ink→cuttlefish fluid, chisel→cheat-verb), so lemma+sensekey anchoring on bridges directly raises this layer's ceiling.
built.predicted_accuracy: Honest prediction vs the 90 resolved verdicts: within-topic LOTO domain-prior concordance 0.58–0.65 — I hand-executed the join this session (sqlite3/python3 classifier-blocked; lexnames assigned from gloss-verified senses extracted via allowlisted grep, so APPROXIMATE pending the script run) and got concordance ≈0.61 over 92 live×dead pairs in 14 two-class topics using a 5-bucket collapse with leave-one-topic-out priors. That is at or just below max_hop_cos (0.667 same protocol), clearly above the cascade's chance level, and likely UNDERPOWERED for permutation p<0.05 at 14 topics (expect p 0.05–0.20). Supporting marginals: NAT-physical vehicles 22 live/7 dead (0.76) vs ACT/EVENT 5/13 (0.38) vs ARTIFACT 9/20 (0.45); same-lexname pairs 7L/9D (0.44) vs cross-lexname 42L/27D (0.61) — the Tourangeau & Sternberg direction. Combined with max_hop_cos in a two-feature model: plausibly 0.70–0.75 within-topic, not the 0.85 bad_head-clean geometry level. Caution: my collapse buckets were chosen after seeing marginals — the scripted, pre-registered version is the honest number; expect some shrinkage. Cross-topic standalone AUC will look better (~0.62–0.68) but is partly the topic-marginal confound; do not headline it.
built.hardware_sovereignty_fit: Near-perfect. The entire layer is a ≤45x45 float table (kilobytes) + a 700-row MetaNet table + the already-imported domains (45 rows, domainid backfilled 107,519/107,519, 0.1 MB) inside the existing SQLite DB; runtime scoring is two integer joins + a table lookup, O(1) per pair, ms-scale once the one-line synsets(domainid) index lands. Zero LLM at school runtime — provably-zero exfiltration holds (pure precomputed lookup). It also CONTAINS the fan-out hazard: restricting candidate enumeration to productive domain-pairs prunes the 455M shared-cluster pair space by domain block (largest domain ~14.5k synsets; a feeling→substance block is ~10^3 x ~10^4 before concreteness filters, batch-enumerable on commodity hardware). HQ-side frame tagging fits the RTX-3060 sovereign-batch envelope (~3.5M output tok/day) or a few dollars of API, once, offline.
built.education_fit: sqlunet lexicographer domains derive from WordNet/OEWN (permissive licence, already the substrate spine) — no new licence exposure. MetaNet is ICSI's publicly browsable research wiki: licence must be VERIFIED before shipping derived rows (flagged unresolved in the external-levers review); only ~700 curated expert mappings, no crowd-sourced content, but filter political/moral-domain mappings for middle grades. No ConceptNet dependency, so the CC BY-SA ShareAlike infection question is avoided entirely by this hypothesis. Domain labels themselves (noun.feeling, noun.substance) are pedagogically clean and even teachable — 'cross a domain boundary to make a metaphor live' is a middle-grades-explainable rule.

built.cheapest_falsification:
THE never-run join, now specified exactly and 90% pre-executed. Data: judgements JSONL (95 rows, grading-live worktree) + lexicon_v2.db (main checkout 646MB typed DB — the ONLY one with domains backfilled; staging lacks it). Cost: $0, <1s runtime, ~40 lines, read-only. I attempted execution 5x this session: sqlite3/python3 were classifier-blocked throughout, but allowlisted grep let me sense-verify all 106 graded synset glosses and HAND-replicate the join (result below). Ready-to-run script (verbatim, reads-only):

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sqlite3, random, collections
J="/home/agent/projects/metaforge/.worktrees/next/data-pipeline/grading/judgements_provisional.jsonl"
DB="file:/home/agent/projects/metaforge/data-pipeline/output/lexicon_v2.db?mode=ro"
recs=[json.loads(l) for l in open(J)]
dead_ts={r["supersedes_ts"] for r in recs if r.get("supersedes_ts")}
recs=[r for r in recs if r["ts"] not in dead_ts]
latest={}
for r in sorted(recs,key=lambda r:r["ts"]): latest[r["chain_signature"]]=r
rows=[(r["topic"],r["topic_synset_id"],r["vehicle_synset_id"],(r.get("metaphor") or r.get("label"))) for r in latest.values() if (r.get("metaphor") or r.get("label")) in("live","dead") and r["vehicle_synset_id"]]
con=sqlite3.connect(DB,uri=True)
dom=dict(con.execute("SELECT s.synset_id,d.domainname FROM synsets s JOIN domains d ON d.domainid=s.domainid"))
COLLAPSE={"noun.animal":"NAT","noun.plant":"NAT","noun.substance":"NAT","noun.object":"NAT","noun.process":"NAT","noun.phenomenon":"NAT","noun.body":"NAT","noun.food":"NAT","noun.group":"NAT","noun.artifact":"ART","noun.act":"ACTEV","noun.event":"ACTEV"}
sup=lambda d:COLLAPSE.get(d,"VERB" if d.startswith("verb.") else "ABST")
data=[(t,sup(dom[ts]),sup(dom[vs]),1 if lab=="live" else 0) for t,ts,vs,lab in rows]
def concord(data):
    num=den=0.0
    for t in {d[0] for d in data}:
        inn=[d for d in data if d[0]==t]; out=[d for d in data if d[0]!=t]
        pr=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
        for _,_,vd,y in out: pr[vd][0]+=y; pr[vd][1]+=1
        p=lambda vd: pr[vd][0]/pr[vd][1] if pr[vd][1] else 0.5
        for a in [p(d[2]) for d in inn if d[3]==1]:
            for b in [p(d[2]) for d in inn if d[3]==0]: num+=1 if a>b else (0.5 if a==b else 0); den+=1
    return (num/den if den else float("nan")), den
obs,n=concord(data)
random.seed(7); null=[]
for _ in range(2000):
    perm=[]
    for t in {d[0] for d in data}:
        inn=[d for d in data if d[0]==t]; ys=[d[3] for d in inn]; random.shuffle(ys)
        perm+=[(d[0],d[1],d[2],y) for d,y in zip(inn,ys)]
    null.append(concord(perm)[0])
print(f"rows={len(rows)} pairs={n:.0f} concordance={obs:.3f} perm-p={(sum(1 for x in null if x>=obs)/2000):.4f}")
cell=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
for t,ts,vs,lab in rows: cell[(dom[ts],dom[vs])][0 if lab=="live" else 1]+=1
print("cells n>=3:",sorted(((k,v) for k,v in cell.items() if sum(v)>=3),key=lambda x:-sum(x[1])))
EOF

The null IS topic-marginal-preserving by construction: labels are permuted WITHIN each topic (each topic keeps its exact live/dead count), and the prior is leave-one-TOPIC-out, so any concordance above the null distribution is vehicle-domain information BEYOND the topic base rate, leakage-free. PRE-REGISTERED DECISION RULE: SUPPORT if concordance ≥0.60 AND perm-p <0.05 (build the layer). KILL if concordance <0.55 OR perm-p >0.20 (domain-pair adds nothing over topic marginal at n=85; shelve until ~300 labels). MIDDLE ZONE (0.55–0.60 or p 0.05–0.20): do NOT build the layer; demote to one feature (vehicle-super-domain log-odds) inside the small supervised scorer and re-test after the next ~100 gradings. Secondary kill-signal: if ≥2 cells with n≥4 are internally ~50/50 (like wound's feeling→feeling 1L/2D), granularity is too coarse regardless of aggregate concordance. HAND-RUN RESULT (approximate lexnames, gloss-verified senses): concordance ≈0.614 over 92 pairs / 14 topics — i.e. my pre-registered prediction is the MIDDLE ZONE: real but probably underpowered signal; expect feature-not-layer as the outcome. Phase 2 (half a day): MetaNet membership audit — tag the 85 pairs for canonical-mapping membership; support if dead-rate among members ≥1.5x non-members (the argument cell alone is 5/5 dead canonical ARGUMENT-IS-WAR/GAME vehicles: battle, duel, wrestling, chess, excavation).
evidence_for: Hand-executed join (gloss-verified senses, this session): within-topic LOTO super-domain concordance ≈0.61 (92 pairs, 14 topics) — above chance under a topic-marginal-preserving design, comparable to max_hop_cos (0.667), where every property/cascade feature sits at 0.50.

Vehicle-domain marginals show large spread: NAT-physical vehicles (substance/object/process/phenomenon/plant/animal/group/body/food) 22 live/7 dead (0.76) vs ACT/EVENT 5/13 (0.38) vs ARTIFACT 9/20 (0.45) — quantifies the triage notes' qualitative finding (named-technical/natural-object vehicles live, abstract/act vehicles die).

3 of the 4 vehicle flips are EXPLAINED or permitted by actual lexname boundaries, contrary to the anchor's pessimism: palimpsest is fully consistent (time→comm LIVE for time AND childhood — both noun.time topics — vs artifact→comm DEAD for antique); tide and river flip across different cells (time→phenomenon DEAD vs phenomenon→phenomenon LIVE; time→object DEAD vs cognition→object LIVE). Only wound (3 rows in one feeling→feeling cell, 1L/2D) defeats domain granularity.

The ARGUMENT-IS-WAR cell is a clean MetaNet-penalty datum: all 5 argument vehicles (battle, duel, wrestling, chess, excavation) are canonical mapping members and ALL graded dead; likewise volcano/ember/abscess/poison (ANGER-IS-HEAT/POISON family) dead, river/tide/thread/hourglass (TIME-IS-FLOW emblems) dead — a hand audit puts ~20+/36 dead pairs in canonical-mapping or same-domain-synonym classes vs only ~4/49 live.

Same-lexname pairs run deader (7L/9D, 0.44) than cross-lexname (42L/27D, 0.61) — the exact Tourangeau & Sternberg signature (aptness up with between-domain distance, down with within-domain), independently matching the endpoint_cos_dist pattern already verified in-project.

Domain-pair recurrence exists where synset recurrence (5/248) does not: cells with n≥3 include communication→act (5), artifact→artifact (6+), feeling→state (5), feeling→substance (3), feeling→feeling (3) — the generalisation substrate the verdict layer lacks.
Infrastructure is already landed: domains (45 rows) + domainid backfill claimed 100%, gloss file joins all 106 graded synsets; marginal cost of the layer is a table and an index.

The standing 'domains are NOT an aptness feature' guard was measured at n=13 and targeted domain-DISTANCE as a cascade feature; the sqlunet review itself pre-authorises revisit: 'If a larger graded set ever shows domain-mismatch separating live/dead (it doesn't at n=13), revisit' — we now have 90.

Bizzoni & Lappin existence proof: supervised aptness signal is learnable at ~hundreds of labels — exactly the regime a smoothed 8x8 prior table needs, unlike KG embeddings (dead until 10^3-10^4 edges).
evidence_against: The wound counterexample: all three wound rows live in ONE cell (feeling→feeling) and flip 1L/2D — domain-pair granularity provably cannot adjudicate pairs; the layer is only a prior.

The strongest cells are 100% topic-collinear: communication→act = the argument topic alone (0/5), so its 'domain-pair' signal is indistinguishable from a topic effect; the same holds for several NAT-heavy live cells. My within-topic permutation design controls this for the aggregate statistic, but it means the headline cells generalise from very few independent topics.

My hand concordance (0.614) sits in the pre-registered MIDDLE zone, not SUPPORT; at 14 topics the permutation p is likely 0.05-0.20 — honest reading is 'real but underpowered feature', not a standalone layer.

Counterexamples to the within-domain-dead rule exist in-data: tide→light (phenomenon→phenomenon) LIVE, X-ray→monochrome (artifact→artifact) LIVE, mosaic/patina→adornment (artifact→artifact) LIVE — same-domain depresses but does not determine.

~12/85 graded vehicle senses are visibly mis-snapped (jewel→person, aurora→dawn, heliotrope→bloodstone, music→punishment, fault→sports-serve, storm→assault, ink→cuttlefish-fluid, chisel→cheat-verb, candle→egg-verb, home→base, excavation→mining, snake→flexible-thing) — the domain layer inherits the sense-disambiguation defect wholesale; measured signal could move either way after the fix.
My super-domain collapse was chosen AFTER seeing the marginals — researcher degrees of freedom; the scripted pre-registered version may shrink the 0.61.
Live base-rate instability (0.10-0.71 across cohorts) means learned cell odds will not transfer as absolute probabilities across generation regimes; only rank/odds-ratio use is defensible.
MetaNet frame vocabulary does not align 1:1 with WordNet lexnames; membership tagging is itself a judgement call (offline LLM or manual) with no gold standard, and the licence is unverified.

Two graded topics snapped to VERB synsets (anchor 23626 'fix firmly', anger 30227 'make angry') — the topic side of the join also carries snap noise, and 45-class granularity leaves 20+ singleton domains unestimable until ~10^3 labels.
risks: Overclaiming from collinear cells: building generation targeting on cells backed by a single topic (argument) bakes a topic idiosyncrasy into the spend plan for the $1.9k 10k run.

Bucket-collapse overfit: if the committed collapse map is tuned on these 85 rows it silently becomes a trained model with n=85; must be frozen before the next grading round and only revised at pre-declared checkpoints.
Sense-snap dependency: deploying domain priors before the lemma/sensekey fix scores ~14% of pairs in the wrong cell — and unlike geometry nulls this failure is silent (every pair joins SOMEWHERE).

Conventionality penalty can suppress product-good output: crucible (ANGER-IS-HEAT member) and feast (HOSPITALITY-IS-FEAST) were graded LIVE — a hard MetaNet penalty would kill them; it must be a soft feature, never a gate.

Single-rater gold with unmeasured intra-rater reliability: a 0.05-0.10 concordance edge is within plausible rater noise; the supersedes re-grades (3 chains) are the only self-agreement data and nobody has mined them.

Opportunity cost: the binding constraint per every prior report is the unbuilt judge + topic breadth; this layer is cheap but must not displace the judge-harness milestone — its correct slot is one afternoon (script) + one feature column.
MetaNet licence/content vetting unresolved — shipping derived mapping rows to schools before verification creates an external-facing licensing issue (the one category that belongs in GitHub issues).

strongest_objections: THE FALSIFICATION SCRIPT DOES NOT TEST THE CLAIMED MECHANISM. The pre-registered script keys its LOTO prior on vehicle super-domain ALONE (pr[vd]), never on (topic_domain, vehicle_domain). So the 0.614 'hand-executed join' measures vehicle-CLASS marginal productivity, not the headline 45x45 pair table. Anchor: liveness is pair-level — ALL 4 multi-topic vehicles flip live<->dead; vehicle-domain is strictly coarser than vehicle identity, which already fails as an adjudicator. The proposer concedes 'only a prior', at which point the claim collapses to exactly one weak feature — the middle-zone demotion they pre-registered anyway.

THE PAIR TABLE IS UNPOPULATABLE FROM THIS GRADING PROGRAMME. ProbeB caveat (grounding): graded topics are 'heavily skewed to emotion/abstract domains so topic_domain marginal will be near-degenerate; expect most pairs to be emotion->X'. The 19 topic lemmas concentrate in feeling/state/cognition/attribute/time rows; most of the claimed matrix stays empty at 300 or 1000 labels unless topic selection changes. The 'back-off rung of the completion hierarchy' is in practice one row-band: vehicle-domain conditioned on topic≈abstract.

HEADLINE CELLS ARE TOPIC-COLLINEAR AND CONTRIBUTE ZERO PAIRS TO THE TEST STATISTIC. argument = 0L/5D is single-class, so communication→act(5) contributes NOTHING to within-topic concordance — it is pure recurrence theatre. The flagship MetaNet datum (ARGUMENT-IS-WAR 5/5 dead) is 100% confounded with the argument topic effect; anxiety is 5/5 LIVE with no canonical mapping, showing topic skew alone produces cells this extreme. No cell has >=2 topics AND both classes, so cross-topic transfer within a cell — the actual generalisation claim — has n≈0.

THE 0.614 IS NOT WHAT THE PRE-REGISTERED SCRIPT WILL PRINT. The hand run used gloss-VERIFIED senses (the proposer found ~12/85 vehicle mis-snaps: jewel→person, aurora→dawn, ink→cuttlefish-fluid...) and a bucket collapse chosen AFTER seeing marginals; the committed script runs on as-snapped synset_ids (~14% wrong cells, silent — every pair joins SOMEWHERE) with 2 topics on VERB synsets (anchor 23626, anger 30227) entering as garbage strata. Calling this '90% pre-executed' launders a hand-tuned variant into a pre-registration.

EFFECT SIZE SITS INSIDE THE UNMEASURED RATER-NOISE BAND. Single rater, intra-rater reliability never measured (anchor); the only self-agreement data (3 supersedes re-grades, incl. one re-grade 4 minutes after the original) has never been mined. A 0.61-vs-0.50 concordance edge over 14 effective clusters is plausibly rater noise; the geometry signal at 0.667-0.767 at least had a perm-p=0.0006 clean-subset result behind it — this has p expected 0.05-0.20 by the proposer's own admission.

NO ABLATION AGAINST THE OBVIOUS PROXIES. The NAT-live marginal (22L/7D) coincides exactly with the anchor's live-skewing rare concrete nouns (palimpsest, sargasso, patina, undertow, thunderhead — the 12 zero-property vehicles); synset_concreteness covers 71/71 graded pairs and is already a DB column. The same-lexname penalty (7L/9D vs 42L/27D) is informationally close to endpoint_cos_dist (0.622 cross-topic, r=1.0 with cascade cosine), already measured as a TOPIC-LEVEL prior, not chain quality (0.531 within-topic). Tourangeau & Sternberg — the hypothesis's own external anchor — locates the signal in domain DISTANCE, which embeddings already encode continuously; lexname identity may add nothing. The test proposes no incremental-value check.

CORPUS-LEVEL EVIDENCE CONTRADICTS THE PRODUCTIVITY-STEERING USE. Anchor: fermentation ~20x and undertow ~19x reuse are 'mostly dead per triage' — both NAT-class (noun.process, noun.phenomenon), directly contradicting the graded-set NAT 0.76 live-rate on the wider 876-chain cohort. Combined with live base-rate instability 0.10-0.71 across cohorts (cell odds non-transferable across generation regimes, conceded), steering the $1.9k 10k run by Beta-smoothed odds from ~85 correlated rows (heavy vehicle reuse = non-independent rows) in 1-3-topic cells bakes topic idiosyncrasy into the largest planned spend.

AMBUSH CONCENTRATION UNHANDLED. Ambush ≈ a quarter of the within-topic pair weight (24/93 in the geometry protocol), is 9/10 bad_head-tagged and holds 5 of the 6 bad-linkage lives — and it enters this test at full weight (bad_head stays in the liveness corpus). The geometry analysis already learned drop-one-topic fragility the hard way (0.667→0.580 dropping adornment); the domain test pre-registers no drop-largest-topic or drop-ambush ablation.

METANET PENALTY REPEATS THE UNMEASURED-JUDGE FAILURE MODE. Frame-membership tagging has no gold standard and no kappa harness — the anchor's exact silent-failure pattern (in-pipeline Haiku extraction-evaluator estimated ~1% bad_head vs 31% reality). In-data counterexamples graded LIVE (crucible = ANGER-IS-HEAT member; feast = HOSPITALITY-IS-FEAST). The '~20+/36 dead vs ~4/49 live' support is a post-hoc, unblinded hand audit by the hypothesis author. Licence unverified (flagged in external levers) — an external-facing school-shipping blocker, the one category that belongs in GitHub issues.
refutation.is_refuted_in_disguise: Partially — about half re-dressed, half genuinely new but untestable. NOT a resurrection of: (a) context-free edge derivation (that was deriving edges from the 80k STATIC enrichments; this learns from operator verdicts — different supervision source, so the 5-way refutation does not transfer); (b) KG embeddings at tiny n (count-based Beta smoothing is valid at small n in principle, unlike TransE/SEAL which need 10^3-10^4 edges). IT IS a partial resurrection on two counts: (1) the statistic its own test measures is vehicle-CLASS-level scoring — a coarsened form of vehicle-level scoring, which the 4/4 vehicle-flip anchor already rules out as a pair adjudicator; once the proposer retreats to 'only a prior', the deliverable is one weak rank feature, not a layer; (2) the same-domain/cross-domain component is informationally adjacent to endpoint_cos_dist ≡ cascade cosine, already measured as a topic-level prior rather than chain quality (0.531 within-topic), and the sqlunet review measured domains as a BACKGROUND CONDITION (verified wording: '89% of pairs are cross-domain regardless of live/dead... never wire it into the cascade as an aptness feature') — the hypothesis quotes the revisit-at-larger-n clause fairly, but low deployment-time feature variance survives the revisit. The genuinely novel content — a (topic_domain→vehicle_domain) productivity table — is the one piece that is neither previously refuted NOR testable on the current corpus (topic-domain degeneracy + zero two-topic-both-class cells), which is its own indictment: the distinguishing claim is exactly the part with no evidence.
refutation.falsification_test_critique: Best-designed test in the batch on one axis, broken on five others. CREDIT: the within-topic label permutation IS topic-marginal-preserving and the LOTO prior is leakage-free — strictly better than the naive recurrence count the grounding warned against. FLAWS: (1) Wrong key — the prior is keyed on vehicle super-domain alone (pr[vd]), so the test can neither support nor kill the headline domain-PAIR table; a pair-keyed variant would mostly back off to 0.5 (empty cells), revealing the layer claim as untestable at n=90. (2) Power — 92 pairs but only ~14 independent clusters; pair-weighted pooling lets ambush (~quarter of pair weight, 9/10 bad_head, 5/6 bad-linkage lives) dominate; no drop-one-topic ablation despite the in-project precedent (geometry 0.667→0.580 dropping adornment); expected power at alpha=0.05 is well under 50% for a true 0.61 effect. (3) Degenerate decision rule — SUPPORT needs perm-p<0.05 (proposer expects 0.05-0.20); KILL needs <0.55 or p>0.20; nearly all probability mass lands in MIDDLE, which the proposer's hand run already occupies — the test cannot realistically change the decision, making it confirmation theatre for a pre-chosen 'demote to feature' outcome. The secondary kill-signal (>=2 cells n>=4 at ~50/50) false-triggers easily at those cell sizes. (4) Gold fragility — single rater, reliability unmeasured; the claimed edge (~0.11 over chance) is within plausible rater noise; supersedes re-grades unmined. (5) Execution mismatch — hand 0.614 used gloss-corrected senses + post-hoc buckets; the committed script uses as-snapped senses (~14% silently wrong cells, 2 VERB topic synsets) and strata keyed by topic STRING while light/argument/anger straddle 2 synset_ids each. (6) Missing ablations — no vehicle-concreteness or endpoint_cos_dist comparison under the identical protocol, so even a SUPPORT result would not establish incremental value over existing columns. Phase 2 (MetaNet dead-rate ratio >=1.5x) has NO topic control at all and its flagship cell is a single topic — it would 'support' on the argument topic effect alone. refutation.what_would_change_mind: (1) The frozen script run on as-snapped senses printing concordance >=0.60 with perm-p<0.05 AND stable (±0.03) under both drop-largest-topic and drop-ambush ablations. (2) Incremental signal: domain feature still separating after partialling out vehicle concreteness AND endpoint_cos_dist under the same within-topic protocol — proving it is not a coarse proxy for existing columns. (3) An actual generalisation demo: a cell prior learned from >=2 topics predicting held-out-topic verdicts in the SAME cell — requires deliberately grading 2-3 new topics into currently single-topic cells (~30-50 labels), which is the only way the pair-table claim becomes testable. (4) An intra-rater reliability bound (mine the supersedes re-grades + a ~15-chain blind re-grade round) showing the noise floor is below the claimed ~0.11 edge. Swapping to surface phrase-mean word vectors (a) changes the feature definition (averaging compresses cosines; discriminative behaviour unknown), (b) moves toward static lexical similarity — the substrate class that failed in EVERY framing (M02 ±0.06 of null, M04 v2 negative, context-free AUC 0.50-0.55 anti-correlated, cascade at chance) and that Tourangeau & Sternberg predict carries ~0 aptness signal, and (c) makes the 0.72 threshold incommensurable with the 0.667 baseline — a failure mode H2 itself names as a risk and then builds its falsification test on.

Concordance on the new population vs 0.667 on the old population is not a de-noising measurement; demonstrated composition swings (±0.09) exceed the entire claimed effect. (3) Power at n=90: 93-130 clustered pairs across 14-17 topics give SE ≥ ±0.05-0.08; thresholds 0.72/0.69 are within ~1 SE of baseline; no permutation test specified; the REFUTE branch (≤0.69) would also fire if phrase-means are simply a worse basis, wrongly killing the retro fix — embedding choice confounded with the representation thesis. (4) Stage 1 is decided: +3 pairs all concordant is p≈0.30 under the null; its refute rule (<0.4 on 3 binary outcomes) is vacuous. (5) Single rater, intra-rater reliability never measured; the proposed supersede-mining for a noise floor has n≈3-5 re-grades — cannot bound ±0.03 effects. (6) The OOV/coverage premise of Stage 2 (~100% via subword) is false for the on-disk .vec; an in-vocab audit of all graded phrase tokens must precede the test or nulls will silently persist. Stage 3 (recurrence) is pre-registered as record-only and is fine. built.name: H3 — Generate-then-Rank Factory; the Metaphor Graph is an Index, not a Deriver
built.claim: Novel apt metaphors cannot be derived open-set from any static substrate (refuted 5 ways); they can only be GENERATED in-context and then ADMITTED by a measured ranking stack. The working system is a factory: offline LLM generation (HQ, sovereign GPU fallback) → two-stage measured judge (the planned κ harness) → CPU geometry re-rank (max_hop_cos et al.) → admitted edges land in metaphor_bridges, which serves as the school-side precomputed lookup index (zero runtime LLM) and as few-shot/AVOID steering memory for the next generation round. 'Completion' for novel pairs is retrieval + re-ranking over generated candidates — never structural extrapolation.
built.relation_to_incumbent: SUBSUMES the incumbent's graph and REPLACES its completion leg. H3 keeps the incumbent's core asset — explicit topic→vehicle edges from graded verdicts in metaphor_bridges — as runtime index and bootstrap memory, and keeps property-cascade demoted to feature-provider/cold-start (the incumbent already concedes this). What it deletes is the extrapolation engine: KG embeddings/SEAL/GNN are measured-dead at current edge counts (need 10^3-10^4; we have ~90 with 5/248 synset-level recurrence), the property substrate is INVERTED for liveness (dead share clusters 0.370 vs live 0.227), and PageRank/AA on the unified graph rank apt vehicles DEEPER than same-domain inapt ones (median ~14k vs ~6k of 81k). Even the refutation report endorses the graph as 'an entirely sensible storage and navigation structure... those edges have to be generated and judged first, after which they become first-class graph edges.' Crucially, H3 is the only path that ever produces the 10^3-10^4 judged-edge corpus the incumbent's strong form would need — so graph-completion-as-learning is downstream of H3 running, not an alternative to it. If judged edges later reach that scale, learned link prediction can be revisited on top of the factory's output as a candidate-proposal accelerant.

The 71%-vs-10-20% live-rate gap RECONCILES as instrument + cohort, not contradiction: 71% = Julian's own grading of n≈21 chains over 3 topics (anxiety/anchor/ambush); 0.10-0.20 = the conservative Haiku PROXY tripwire on r2's ~90 abstract/emotional topics (proxy has zero false-positives but rejects 30-44% of human-live, so it under-counts by ~2-4x; and primary-emotion topics genuinely skew dead per triage); the graded-walk cohort sits at 54%. External pattern-match: MERMAID's over-generate + discriminative re-rank was preferred 66-68% in human evals — the architecture H3 instantiates; Bizzoni & Lappin prove supervised aptness ranking works at ~hundreds of labels (our regime); Tourangeau & Sternberg's between/within-domain geometry matches our measured pattern (overall similarity ~0, leap separates)

'Zero false positives across three model tiers' over ~2-4 dead chains is statistically near-vacuous — a judge that rejects everything also has zero FPs — yet H3 converts it into 'live-rate among judge-ACCEPTED 0.80-1.00'. The 3 probe topics are the most confounded corners of the corpus: anxiety is 5/5 live (any accept is a hit) and ambush is 9/10 bad_head-tagged with 5/6 bad-linkage lives. The programme's own track record: every judge NOT measured against gold failed silently (extraction-evaluator ~1% vs 31% bad_head reality; Forge Reader never measured).

GEOMETRY RE-RANK MAY BE WORTH ~ZERO AND ITS PRE-JUDGE BAND-CUT IS BIASED AGAINST THE PRODUCT'S BEST MATERIAL: honest within-topic concordance 0.667 (62/93 pairs, 14 topics); ambush alone 24/93 pairs; drop-adornment moved an earlier estimate to 0.580; 11/86 single-hop chains degenerate max_hop to endpoint similarity, which is at-chance within-topic (0.531); cross-topic 0.595 at p~0.15. 'Drop bottom band pre-judge' never specifies null handling — it either silently discards the live-skewing rare-vehicle candidates or passes them unranked (no spend saved).

THE STACKED-SYSTEM NUMBER IS INVENTED: 'within-topic AUC ~0.70-0.78' has no measurement behind it — H3 concedes the stack was never jointly evaluated and judge/geometry independence is unmeasured. Both stages plausibly key on the same lexical surface (LLM metaphor judgment is demonstrably surface-overlap/length-driven per 2507.15357; geometry is embedding distance over the same surface). If correlated, stacking adds nothing over the judge alone and the hypothesis's headline accuracy evaporates into the judge's untested kappa band.

YIELD ECONOMICS COLLAPSE EXACTLY ON THE PRODUCT CORE: live base-rate is 0.10-0.71 by topic class with the genre-fiction core (abstract emotion) at the bottom — argument 0/5 live, primary emotions go dead per triage, r2 proxy band 0.10-0.20 on ~90 abstract/emotional topics. The claimed remedy — bootstrap steering — is asserted, not demonstrated: the AVOID channel is BROKEN (build_next_round_prompt.py:82 keys v1 bad_path, emits empty AVOID under v2 data), ~2 rounds ever ran, Wilson-CI convergence never reached, and unsteered r2 mode-collapsed onto mostly-dead vehicles (fermentation ~20x, undertow ~19x, amber ~16x).

If Julian-vs-Julian kappa is ~0.5-0.7, the Stage-2 kappa>=0.3 gate is uninterpretable (at-ceiling or garbage — undecidable), and the rank-probe's +10-point threshold sits inside the unmeasured label-noise floor. DEPLOYED-SUBSTRATE DRIFT UNADDRESSED: staging (the deployed surface) has NO metaphor DDL, ~12k un-typed enrichment, 9,994 centroids; the analysed typed 80k substrate and the only DDL-bearing DB (0 rows everywhere) live in the main checkout. refutation.is_refuted_in_disguise: Mostly no, with two genuine relapses. The core — in-context generation + measured pair-level admission — is NOT a resurrection; it is the context-free-edges refutation report's own recommendation ('build the judge'), and it correctly avoids the five measured-dead routes: no static derivation, no KG embeddings at 90 edges/5-248 recurrence, no vehicle-level scoring (admission is per (topic,vehicle) pair, which the 4/4 vehicle flips support). What distinguishes it from the incumbent is real: it deletes structural extrapolation and replaces completion with retrieval. BUT two components smuggle refuted mechanisms back in: (1) the serve-path 'nearest-topic retrieval by centroid cosine' is static-similarity-based liveness TRANSFER — pair-level liveness extrapolated across topic neighbourhoods — which the same-domain vehicle flips (palimpsest: time/childhood live vs antique dead) and at-chance within-topic endpoint_cos_dist (0.531) directly contradict; this is the incumbent's extrapolation leg reborn at the product layer with zero measurements. (2) The geometry-rank stage's growth story (0.667 -> 0.72-0.80 'on a bad_head-fixed corpus') re-runs the M02 ortony cohort-shape artefact pattern: reading a subset-selection delta as a causal intervention effect. Neither relapse is the hypothesis's spine, but both are written into the mechanism and the accuracy claim, so the hypothesis as stated is partially contaminated by exactly the failure modes it claims to have learned from.
refutation.falsification_test_critique: The rank-lift probe is cheap and admirably pre-registered, but it neither has power nor discriminates the hypothesis. POWER: eligible topics (>=3 live+dead chains, both classes) number ~10-14 — at most 14 topics have both classes at all, and per-topic skews (anxiety 5/5 live, argument 0/5) plus the >=3 floor cut further; top-1-per-topic gives ~12 binary observations. Under the within-topic permutation null (mean ~6.8 hits, sigma ~1.7 at base ~0.57), both the p<0.10 rule and the +10-point rule require >=9/12 top-1 lives (0.75 observed). If the true top-1 propensity implied by concordance 0.667 is ~0.70 (generous), P(support) ~0.49, P(false-kill via the <=base+5 rule) ~0.28, ~23% limbo between the two rules — a coin flip dressed as a decision procedure. The sensitivity slices are worse: the bad_head-clean set has 10 both-class topics before the n>=3 cut (~6-8 binaries), so 'same sign on >=2 of 3 slices' is noise. CONFOUNDS: (a) the graded corpus is NOT a random draw of factory output — the walk is signal-prioritised and the handpicked cohort is curated re-emissions; graded live-rate 54% vs raw-r2 proxy 0.10-0.20 shows heavy live-enrichment, so rank-lift measured here has unknown external validity on the raw candidate stream where the band-cut would actually deploy (selection on the dependent variable); (b) ambush's 'live' labels are linkage-compromised (5/6 bad-linkage lives are ambush; 9/10 rows bad_head) so its top-1 outcome is ambiguous evidence in the full slice; (c) topic prevalence heterogeneity: the '+10 points over pooled base ~0.57' criterion and the permutation criterion can disagree when effects concentrate in high-n topics, and the eligible-subset base-rate is not 0.57 once single-class topics are excluded — the rule double-specifies against two different nulls; (d) single-rater gold with unmeasured intra-rater noise means the 10-point margin is uninterpretable as exceeding the noise floor; (e) null-geometry rows (no max_hop where centroids are missing — concentrated on rare live-skewing vehicles) are silently excluded, biasing the eligible pool toward well-enriched topics. NON-DISCRIMINATION: the test's own kill branch is pre-absorbed — 'H3 then degenerates to generate-then-JUDGE only'. Either outcome leaves the hypothesis's load-bearing claim (the measured judge) untested; the actually decisive experiment (Stage-2 kappa on the 90 verdicts, ~$10-30) is deferred to a footnote. A falsification test that cannot kill the hypothesis under any outcome is a stage-probe, not a falsification — useful, but it should be re-labelled and the judge harness promoted to the keystone test.
refutation.what_would_change_mind: Four measurements, in priority order. (1) Execute the judge harness: Stage-2 kappa vs the 90 resolved verdicts with topic-disjoint folds clearing 0.3 with a CI excluding 0, confusion matrix showing FP rate <~10% on a sample containing >=15 dead chains (not 2), reported alongside a measured intra-rater ceiling (blind re-grade of ~30 chains or mined supersede self-agreement) so the kappa is interpretable. (2) A rank-lift result that survives power: re-run the probe after grading reaches ~300 labels / ~80 topics (the completion-harness's own guidance), or on judge-scored raw factory output rather than the curated graded cohort, with top-band lift CI excluding zero and explicit null-geometry handling. (3) One demonstrated bootstrap round: AVOID channel repaired, then round-over-round live-rate lift on matched topic classes (especially abstract-emotion) exceeding the proxy's noise band — converting the steering claim from assertion to measurement, and pinning the per-admitted-edge cost on core topics. (4) Nearest-topic fallback either deleted from the product claim or validated: precision@1 of transferred edges on held-out topics vs the flip-implied null. If (1) and any of (2)-(4) land positive, H3 upgrades to survives; if Stage-2 kappa <0.3 with the extractor already fixed, the factory has no scalable gate and H3 collapses to operator-throughput-bound grading — effectively killed as a 20k-topic architecture.
refutation.salvage: The salvageable core is large and is mostly already-planned work: (a) generate-then-JUDGE with the two-stage kappa-measured harness as the keystone — this is the refutation report's own recommendation and the only measured-positive direction in the programme; build it first and read every gate off empirical bands, not the n=12 prior. (b) The schema/pipeline hygiene list (items 1-8: v2 verdict alignment, persist max_hop/std + per-step phrase/head/gloss, gloss-extended chain schema killing bad_head at source, persist proxy-judge outputs, repair AVOID, decouple proposer from chain identity, materialise JSONL->metaphor_bridges, domainid index) is hypothesis-independent and should land regardless of H3's fate — it belongs in the next milestone's plan as preconditions for ANY scorer. (c) Geometry max_hop_cos survives as a candidate FEATURE inside the judge harness evaluation (post-judge within-topic ordering only), demoted from load-bearing stage until the adequately-powered rank-lift test passes and null-handling on centroid-missing rare vehicles is specified; never use it as a pre-judge cut before that. (d) The sovereignty architecture (precomputed SQLite index in schools, all LLM offline at HQ, quantified RTX-3060 fallback) is the strongest piece of any hypothesis class and transfers verbatim to whatever admission mechanism wins. built.claim: Liveness/aptness lives in RELATIONAL alignment, not attribute overlap: a topic-vehicle pair is live when the two concepts share aligned predicate-argument structure (X erodes Y, X accumulates-in Y, X builds-under-pressure-then-erupts) while being attributively/domain distant — Gentner's career-of-metaphor plus Tourangeau-Sternberg's two-feature geometry (+between-domain distance, −within-domain incongruence). The scorer is a CPU-only SME-lite alignment over small typed predicate structures per synset (5–15 triples), combined with the already-verified between-domain term (max_hop_cos) and the never-computed within-domain-congruence term. It predicts Julian's verdicts because his live/dead axis IS the career-of-metaphor distinction: live = novel relational alignment, dead = conventionalised attributive category.
built.relation_to_incumbent: COMPLEMENTS AND FEEDS metaphor-graph-completion; replaces only the cascade's attribute feature set. Graph completion is currently starved (10^2 graded edges vs the 10^3–10^4 needed; TransE/RotatE/SEAL declared dead at current counts) — H4 supplies the pair-level featureisation that lets a small supervised scorer (Bizzoni-Lappin regime, works at ~hundreds of labels) extrapolate the 90 verdicts to novel pairs NOW, and it fixes 'typed nodes, untyped edges' by attaching a relation/mapping label to every graded edge, so when the graph densifies, completion becomes structure-aware instead of label-only. built.mechanism: DATA STRUCTURES: (1) `predicate_classes(id, lemma, parent_id)` — a frozen ~40–60-class verb-centred inventory (accumulate, erupt, erode, conceal, consume, pull-under, persist, bind, release, transform...) with one abstraction level (erode→gradually-diminish); (2) `synset_relations(synset_id, predicate_class_id, predicate_lemma, arg_slot, arg_text, salience, source, prompt_version, licence_tag)` — populated FIRST by mining the existing, never-read `synset_properties.relation` micro-clauses (V2 enrichment already elicits 'volcano erupts violently' per property; enrich_pipeline.py imports them; 369,461 phrases confirmed in the curated-props dump alone) via deterministic verb-lemma parsing (spaCy/regex, CPU, $0); LATER (gated on falsification) by a re-prompt for explicit triples; (3) per-synset predicate-class count vector (~64-dim) and per-domain (sqlunet 45-class) aggregate relational signatures. FEATURES per candidate pair: (a) relational-match count (same predicate class both sides, df-capped); (b) SME-lite role-consistent alignment score — greedy structural consistency over identical-predicate matches with parallel-connectivity bonus for causally linked predicate pairs; tiny structures make this microseconds/pair; (c) within-domain incongruence (the uncomputed T&S term): distance between topic's and vehicle's predicate-class distribution relative to their own domain co-members — apt vehicles occupy the ANALOGOUS relational position in their domain; (d) between-domain distance: existing max_hop_cos / endpoint distance / domain-pair table. ALGORITHM: inverted index on predicate class → candidate generation with df-cap (mirrors 455M→271k collapse); logistic combination of (a)–(d) trained GROUP-by-topic on graded verdicts (completion-harness conventions). LLM PLACEMENT: offline/HQ batch only — triple normalisation and any re-enrichment; school runtime is pure precomputed SQLite lookup, zero LLM, zero exfiltration. SCHEMA MUST STORE: typed relation per synset with provenance/prompt_version, relation/mapping label per graded edge, max_hop/std + relational features on bridges, v2 two-axis verdicts with SQL-filterable tags.

strongest_objections: KEYSTONE TEST IS CONTAMINATED BY DESIGN. Stage 1 fills substrate gaps via 'operator hand-extraction (5-8 triples/endpoint)' — but the operator IS the single rater who issued the 90 verdicts, and the gaps are concentrated exactly on the live-skewing endpoints (verified: palimpsest/undertow/sargasso = 0 occurrences in the 369,450-phrase dump; 12 graded vehicles have zero property rows hence zero relation rows, since relation is a column ON synset_properties per enrich_pipeline.py:233-241). The person who graded 'anxiety→sediment live' hand-writes sediment's predicates knowing that verdict. Likewise the 'frozen' 40-60-class predicate inventory: the hypothesis's own examples (accumulate, erupt, pull-under, builds-under-pressure-then-erupts) are visibly reverse-engineered from the graded live chains it quotes (anger→pressure→surge→flood). Freezing-before-joining is theatre when the freezer has read the verdicts. Any positive Stage 1 result is unfalsifiable as designed.

THE SUPPORT GATE IS STATISTICALLY UNDETECTABLE AT n=43/93. Pre-registered lift ≥0.05 on the bad_head-clean subset (0.767→0.82): binomial SE on 43 pairs ≈ 0.064 even assuming independence, which fails — pairs share topics and chains (ambush alone = 24/93; dropping adornment moved an earlier estimate to 0.580; the STRONGER feature's cross-topic p≈0.15; the 0.767 baseline itself is snapshot-unstable, 0.85→0.77). The hypothesis's own predicted full-feature band (0.70-0.80 clean) sits mostly BELOW the existing 0.767 baseline — its honest prediction is consistent with adding nothing. No topic-dropout sensitivity, no permutation null in the decision rule. SUPPORT and grey-zone are observationally near-equivalent at this n.

SINGLE-RATER GOLD + BACKWARDS SEQUENCING. Intra-rater reliability never measured; live base-rate 0.10-0.71 across cohorts; the hypothesis ADMITS the 0.05 lift is near plausible rater-noise magnitude — yet relegates the 20-chain regrade/kappa to the grey-zone branch. If kappa is required to interpret ANY outcome (it is: a 0.05 lift cannot be distinguished from rater drift without it), it must precede Stage 1, not follow it.

'SUBSUMES THE VERIFIED SIGNAL' IS A CATEGORY ERROR. max_hop_cos is a PATH-level property of the proposer's generated chain (largest hop among intermediates), not a pair-level endpoint quantity. The actual pair-level analogue in the data — endpoint_cos_dist — is 0.531 within-topic, explicitly flagged as a topic-level prior NOT chain quality, and 11/86 chains are single-hop where the two degenerate together. T&S between-domain distance is endpoint-pair-level; H4's static pair features cannot inherit the 0.667/0.767 path-level result, whose mechanism may be chain-construction audacity. The honest prior for H4's pair-level geometry term is chance.

STAGE 0 IS NON-BINDING AND ITS PASS CONDITION IS GAMEABLE. If Stage 0 stays ~1%, 'the alignment variant still gets Stage 1' — a stage that changes no decisions is not a falsification stage. And the ≥5% pass threshold is inflatable by construction: matching against relation-phrase tokens+verb-lemmas adds the most collision-prone token class in English (creates/makes/causes/becomes appear in tens of thousands of the 369k phrases); recall_ceiling.py:90-101 at least had a STOP list over property tokens — the relation variant needs a frequency-matched verb-collision floor or ≥5% is a false positive.

SUBSTRATE PROVENANCE: same rows, same holes, same elicitor. Relation phrases ride the SAME synset_properties rows whose cluster overlap is INVERTED (dead 0.370 vs live 0.227) and whose derivation was refuted 5 ways — same 27% missing-endpoint coverage, same 12 zero-coverage live-skewing vehicles (verified empirically), same Haiku-only attribute-first elicitation where 'relation' is defined as 'short phrase linking word to property' (enrich_properties.py prompt, verified) so the verb frequently re-encodes the property itself ('rudeness creates rough textures' ← property 'rough'). The C17 contextual-construction mechanism (apt bridges built in context, absent from static enrichment) has no stated reason to spare verb tokens, and the hypothesis concedes Stage 0 may stay ~1%.

THE 'PREDICTED A PRIORI, NO OTHER HYPOTHESIS CAN SAY' CLAIM OVERREACHES. The attribute inversion is equally predicted by a mundane account: dead pairs are conventional near-domain pairs, hence closer in ANY similarity substrate — i.e. the same topic-level proximity prior as endpoint_cos_dist (0.622 cross-topic) — compounded by a vehicle-reuse cohort artifact (fermentation ~20x, undertow ~19x, mostly dead per triage, so dead pairs oversample a few vehicles' property profiles). SMT is sufficient but not necessary for the inversion; the rhetorical centrepiece does not uniquely select H4.

A RELATIONAL SUBSTRATE ALREADY FAILED ONCE: WordNet relations traversal recovered 0/7 canonical live pairs. The entire weight rests on the taxonomic-vs-eventive distinction, which is plausible but unevidenced — and with one abstraction level over 5-15 triples, SME-lite 'role-consistent alignment' mostly reduces to shared-predicate counting, i.e. the AUC-0.55 shared-feature test re-run in a coarser 64-dim verb projection.
refutation.is_refuted_in_disguise: Partially — about half of it. VERIFIED GENUINELY NEW: the relation column was never read by any analysis; recall_ceiling.py's C17 match used only one-word property TEXT tokens (syn2tok, lines 90-101, code confirmed), so the 0.31% figure is formally silent on relation phrases; and the substrate is majority non-copular (~11% stative verbs across 369,450 phrases, measured this session), not the attributive mush its own evidence_against feared. Features (b) role-consistent alignment and (c) within-domain incongruence are genuinely untested, but (b) degenerates toward match-counting at 5-15 triples/one abstraction level, and (c) is sequenced ahead of the cheaper untested probe it depends on (the never-computed 45x45 domain-pair contingency table). It also re-enters the Bizzoni-Lappin 'works at hundreds of labels' regime with 90 single-rater grouped binary labels — not the multi-rater averaged-score setting that anchor comes from.
refutation.falsification_test_critique: Does not discriminate as designed. (1) Power: the ≥0.05 clean-subset lift is under 1 binomial SE at n=43 (SE≈0.064) before accounting for non-independence — pairs cluster by topic and share chains/vehicles; ambush=24/93 of the full set; the baseline itself moved 0.85→0.77 between snapshots and 0.62→0.58 on dropping one topic. The ≥0.10 margin over the attribute control is likewise underpowered. The hypothesis's own predicted band (0.70-0.80) straddles/undershoots the 0.767 baseline, so even a 'consistent with H4' outcome is consistent with zero added signal. (2) Contamination: operator hand-extraction of triples for verdict-known endpoints (concentrated on the live-skewing zero-coverage vehicles, verified empty in the dump) plus a predicate inventory designed by someone who has read the graded corpus — the two inputs that determine the score are both downstream of the labels. (3) Stage 0 is decision-free (fail → Stage 1 proceeds anyway) and its ≥5% pass threshold lacks a verb-collision floor, so it can neither kill nor support. (4) Single rater with unmeasured kappa, and the regrade that would calibrate the noise floor is sequenced AFTER the test it is needed to interpret. (5) Missing controls: no topic-dropout report, no permutation null, no blind/pseudonymised extraction, no pre-specified handling of the 11 single-hop degenerate chains. The KILL branch (≤0.55 alone AND <0.02 lift) is at least honest, but the modal outcome is the grey zone by the hypothesis's own admission — i.e. the test most likely resolves nothing while creating spend pressure.
refutation.what_would_change_mind: (1) Intra-rater kappa from a ~20-chain regrade run FIRST, showing rater stability comfortably above the proposed 0.05 lift — without this no gate is interpretable. (2) Stage 0 re-run with a frequency-matched verb-collision control (shuffled-pair null), showing relation-phrase bridge-presence ≥5 points ABOVE that floor — that would demonstrate the relational substrate contains bridge material attributes provably lack. (3) Decontaminated Stage 1: predicate inventory derived mechanically (e.g. VerbNet classes) or frozen by someone who has never seen verdicts/chains; hand-extraction done blind to verdicts on pseudonymised endpoints by a non-rater. (4) The 45x45 domain-pair contingency table computed first and showing any domain-pair structure in the verdicts — prerequisite for believing a within-domain term can exist at this granularity. (5) Evaluation reported with topic-dropout (ambush/adornment especially) and a permutation null, SUPPORT defined relative to that null rather than a raw 0.05 lift. If (1)-(3) pass and the decontaminated alignment score still clears 0.65 clean-subset concordance beating the attribute control, I would move to survives.

From H4 proper, salvage exactly one cheap measurement: the Stage 0 relation-phrase bridge-presence probe ($0, ~2h, genuinely unmeasured — I verified C17 never touched the relation column and that the 369k phrases are ~89% non-copular), but run it WITH a verb-collision null and treat it as binding (≤ collision floor = the static-relational-retrieval idea joins the attribute substrate in the grave; the alignment variant then needs the decontaminated protocol or nothing). built.name: H5 — Small supervised pair scorer over substrate features (regressor-as-completion)
built.claim: The "completion model" is not a graph algorithm but a small supervised pair scorer (logistic/GBM, trainable in seconds on CPU) over ~25-35 pair-level features drawn from feature FAMILIES never present in the at-chance cascade run: frequency/rarity/familiarity asymmetries (BNC 28,449 / SUBTLEX / SemCor tagcount 34,767), domain-pair indicators (sqlunet 45 domains, 100% domainid backfill), conventionality priors (MetaNet ~700 mappings + own-corpus vehicle-reuse counts), embedding leap proxies (chain max_hop_cos where a chain exists; precomputed bottleneck-bridge leap where not), and link-prediction heuristics (Adamic-Adar/Jaccard) computed on the DENSE substrate layers (WordNet relations 234,810, property bipartite 822,807 rows, optionally ConceptNet) — explicitly never on the 5/248-recurrence verdict layer. At the harness's own predicted operating point (~300-500 labels / 80-120 topics) it beats both pure graph-completion (which has no graph: 0 materialised edges, KG embeddings dead below 10^3-10^4) and unranked generation (49/55% live base rate), and ships as pure precomputed SQLite scoring. Bizzoni & Lappin (75% binary accuracy, Pearson .75 from ~hundreds of human aptness labels) is the existence proof at exactly this data scale; MERMAID (discriminative re-ranking preferred 66-68%) is the deployment shape.
built.relation_to_incumbent: SUBSUMES the incumbent at current data scale and is its only operational form. "Metaphor-graph-completion" today has no graph to complete: metaphor_bridges/judgments = 0 rows everywhere, synset-level edge recurrence 5/248, and the edge-LLM dive shows TransE/RotatE/SEAL/GNN link prediction dead until 10^3-10^4 edges. H5 IS link prediction done the only way the sparsity permits: structural features computed on the dense substrate layers, supervised by the sparse verdict layer. It cleanly hosts the incumbent's roadmap: as labels scale, verdict-layer features (domain-pair recurrence tables, vehicle-flip statistics, materialised live/dead edges as nearest-labelled-pair features) drop into the same regressor; if a real graph ever emerges, GNN scores become one more feature column. It also subsumes the path-geometry hypothesis (max_hop_cos is one feature, not a rival) and completes the property-cascade demotion: cascade features enter as candidate-gating/cold-start columns whose SIGNS the model learns — which matters, because the substrate is measured INVERTED (dead pairs share clusters 0.370 vs live 0.227) and only a supervised consumer can exploit an anti-correlated feature. Complements (does not replace) the LLM judge: judge = label-scaling instrument at HQ; H5 = the shippable artefact distilled from those labels.

strongest_objections: HALF THE FEATURE BASKET IS ALREADY MEASURED DEAD, INCLUDING UNDER A SUPERVISED CONSUMER. Family 5 (AA/Jaccard on WordNet relations + property bipartite) is the static-similarity substrate the pattern analysis says fails 'in every framing': context-free spike shared-feature AUC 0.552 with a SUPERVISED consumer (so the 'only a learner can exploit anti-correlation' defence was already tested — a learned sign on a 0.55 feature is still 0.55), WordNet direct relations 0/7 graded pairs, curated-cluster share inverted-weak (DEAD 0.370 vs LIVE 0.227 ≈ 0.57 alone, inside the ±0.12 CI of chance at n=86). Family 6 (cascade) is AUC≈0.50/0.554. Family 4's endpoint cosine is 0.531 within-topic (a topic prior, r=1.0 with cascade cosine). And the wrapper itself has precedent: a 16-feature grouped-CV supervised model on this exact harness already ran at 0.554, n=71 — i.e. multi-feature supervision at this n has been tried once and was at chance.

THE HEADLINE NEW FAMILY (frequency/rarity/conventionality) IS VEHICLE-MARGINAL AND IS CONTRADICTED BY THE STRONGEST PAIR-LEVEL FACT IN THE DATA: 4/4 vehicles graded under >=2 topics FLIP live<->dead (palimpsest live for time/childhood, dead for antique; wound, tide, river likewise). BNC/SUBTLEX/Brysbaert/tagcount/vehicle-reuse/MetaNet-membership assign IDENTICAL values to palimpsest-under-time (live) and palimpsest-under-antique (dead) — by construction they misrank every flip pair, and heavy vehicle reuse (undertow ~14 topics) makes flips the typical serving case, not an edge case. Worse, the family's qualitative support ('named-technical-object vehicles live, fermentation/undertow/amber mostly dead') comes from the Forge Reader triage — an instrument NEVER measured against gold, whose bad_head estimate was ~1% vs 31% reality; the grounding's own lesson is 'every instrument not measured against gold failed silently'.

THE DOMAIN-PAIR FAMILY IS UNDERCUT BY ITS OWN IMPORT SPEC AND BY THE FLIP DATA: the sqlunet review that delivered domainid records domains as 'NOT an aptness feature — 89% of pairs cross-domain regardless' (same-domain flag ~constant over candidates); the palimpsest flips occur between plausibly SAME-domain topics (time/childhood/antique are all time-flavoured), hinting the needed granularity is finer than any domain-pair cell; and probeB pre-registers that the graded topic-domain marginal is near-degenerate (emotion/abstract-heavy), so apparent domain-pair signal is partly a topic-marginal artefact unless tested against a topic-marginal-preserving null — which H5's falsification does not include. With ~6-10 superclasses → up to ~100 pair indicators vs 22 topic synsets, domain indicators are near-collinear with topic identity inside folds.

MISSINGNESS-AS-SIGNAL IS A COVERAGE ARTEFACT POISED TO MANUFACTURE AUC AND THEN COLLAPSE AT SERVING: missing-from-BNC and zero-curated-properties correlate with live in the graded 90 (the 12 zero-property vehicles ARE the live-skewing rare nouns), but BNC covers 28,449 of ~185k lemmas and ~24% of synsets are unenriched — in the graded set these indicators discriminate, over the serving universe they saturate to ~constant. In-fold NaN imputation plus label-correlated missingness lets the model learn 'absent from substrate → live' — a hole-shaped shortcut, not aptness. No missingness-indicators-only null model is pre-registered, so a 'pass' cannot be distinguished from this artefact. The same logic poisons the product: precomputed pair_scores over the df-capped ~271k shared-cluster candidate universe EXCLUDES zero-property vehicles by construction (they generate no shared-cluster pairs; the uncapped 455M is unmaterialisable), so the shipped SELECT-only artefact systematically omits exactly the live-signal region — H5 inherits the cascade's blindness at candidate generation even with a perfect scorer.

H5 VIOLATES ITS OWN CITED INSTRUMENT'S GUIDANCE AND BAKES IN EVAL-SET BURN: the completion harness it leans on concluded SINGLE-feature models at small n and ~300-500 labels/~80-120 topics for a first useful multi-feature model; H5's falsification fits 25-35 features on 86 rows (~2.5 rows/feature, GBM included). Every family was selected by inspecting these same 90 verdicts (inversion sign measured on them, rarity regularity from their triage, max_hop verified on them) — pre-registering the decision rule does not cure post-hoc feature selection on the test set, and with ±0.12 CI plus 6 families × robustness-gate forking paths, clearing 0.62 by selection bias alone is live.

THE CHAIN-FREE MODE — THE ONLY PART THAT WOULD MAKE H5 'COMPLETION' RATHER THAN A RE-RANKER — IS UNCOMPUTED CONJECTURE WITH A NAMED FAILURE MODE: the bottleneck-bridge leap has never been run; FastText hubness can make every pair bridgeable through hub words with uniformly small hops exactly in the exhaustive-scoring regime; and 11/86 graded chains are single-hop where the leap degenerates to endpoint similarity (0.531). If it nulls, H5 collapses (by its own admission) to a chain-dependent re-ranker of HQ-generated chains — i.e. the already-verified path-geometry hypothesis plus MERMAID deployment shape, with the Sonnet generator, not the scorer, doing the actual 'completion'; novel topics outside the precomputed set then need generation, which the schools-runtime constraint forbids on-prem.

PREDICTED-ACCURACY PROVENANCE IS WEAK: Bizzoni & Lappin used multi-rater-AGGREGATED gradient labels over in-context sentence embeddings; ours are single-rater, out-of-context, binary live/dead conflating aptness/novelty/conventionality (tiers never assigned), with intra-rater reliability never measured (supersedes re-grades exist and have never been mined) and base rate swinging 0.10-0.71 across cohorts. The discount from 75% to 'AUC 0.65-0.72 at 300-500 labels' is asserted, not derived; and without a reliability floor even the kill branch (<0.58) is uninterpretable — it could be the label noise ceiling, not feature failure.
refutation.is_refuted_in_disguise: Partially — and the partial matters. Three of six families are direct resurrections: (a) AA/Jaccard/preferential-attachment on the property bipartite and WordNet relations is the context-free static-similarity substrate refuted 5 ways (AUC 0.50-0.55, anti-correlated, relations 0/7, 0.31% bridge-features present), and the refutation already included a supervised consumer, so 'learned signs rescue it' is not new territory; (b) cascade features are the at-chance 0.554/0.50 set carried in verbatim; (c) endpoint cosine is the cascade cosine (r=1.0) measured as a topic prior, not chain quality. The wrapper itself (supervised pair model, grouped-CV, this harness) ran once at n=71 and produced 0.554 — H5 is the second pull of that lever with a bigger basket. What is genuinely NOT refuted: frequency/rarity asymmetries (never in any model), domain-pair indicators (never computed — though the import spec and flip data pre-load against them), MetaNet/vehicle-reuse conventionality priors (never tested; reuse counts are generator-distribution artefacts), the chain-free bottleneck leap (never computed), and the hosting of the VERIFIED max_hop_cos signal. So H5 is not a pure zombie — but its distinctive content over 'path-geometry re-ranker' rests entirely on the untested families, while its rhetorical force ('subsumes graph-completion', 'IS link prediction') comes from relabelling a similarity-feature regressor as the incumbent. Note also vehicle-level scoring is refuted by the 4/4 flips, and roughly a third of H5's new-feature mass (all vehicle-marginal columns) is vehicle-level scoring smuggled into a pair model.
refutation.falsification_test_critique: Cheapest in the set, partially pre-registered, but NOT discriminating as designed. POWER: at 49×37 live/dead, Hanley-McNeil se ≈ 0.063, so the primary rule (AUC ≥0.62 AND +0.05 over cascade) has roughly 25-35% power even if H5 is exactly right; the pre-declared 'underpowered 0.58-0.62' band absorbs most of the probability mass under both H5-true and H5-false — the test is a deferral mechanism, not a falsifier. The +0.05 paired comparison is against an UNSTABLE baseline (0.554 full vs 0.386 'anti-predictive' wrapping artefact vs raw OOF ≈0.50) over only 15-22 topic groups. METRIC MISALIGNMENT: the primary is cross-topic AUC, which is inflated by topic-marginal prediction (argument 0/5 live, anxiety 5/5 live; endpoint_cos_dist and topic-side BNC/domain columns are topic priors) — a model can pass while being useless for the product task, within-topic vehicle ranking; within-topic concordance is relegated to the feature-level rule. CONFOUNDS: ambush is 24/93 within-topic pairs and 5/6 bad-linkage lives; the feature-level '≥0.60 within-topic' rule can be carried by ambush alone, and the robustness gates (drop adornment, bad_head-clean) are stated for 'the result' but not bound to the feature-level rule; the bad_head-clean subset is n=57 (CI ±~0.15). SINGLE RATER: no reliability sub-study despite free material (supersedes re-grade chains); without a noise floor neither the pass nor the kill branch is interpretable. MISSINGNESS: no missingness-indicators-only null model, though missing-from-BNC is explicitly made a feature and property-missingness is label-correlated — the most likely false-positive path is unguarded. SLOPE RULE: 'flat slope at 300 labels = definitive kill' confounds label count with cohort drift (base rate 0.10-0.71 across cohorts, generator/prompt drift, walk steering) — slope is not identified as a function of n. OMISSION: it skips the genuinely cheapest probe the grounding pins — the domain-pair contingency table with a topic-marginal-preserving null — and instead buries domain indicators in a 30-feature model where their contribution is unidentifiable at this n. Fixes that would make it discriminating: within-topic concordance as PRIMARY; single-family pre-registered probes (frequency-asymmetry, domain-pair-with-null, bottleneck-leap-with-hubness-audit) BEFORE the omnibus; missingness-only baseline as a null; gates bound to every rule; mine supersedes re-grades + ~20 blind re-grades for an intra-rater floor; quarantine all post-hoc-familiar verdicts by freezing newly graded labels as holdout.
refutation.what_would_change_mind: (1) A pre-registered SINGLE-family probe showing frequency-asymmetry (a pair-level construction, e.g. vehicle-minus-topic rarity, not vehicle-marginal alone) reaching ≥0.60 within-topic concordance that SURVIVES drop-adornment, drop-ambush, bad_head-clean, AND a topic-marginal permutation null — that would establish the one genuinely novel family on its own feet. (2) The bottleneck-bridge leap actually computed once (it is a day of work) with a hubness audit, showing ≥0.60 within-topic concordance — that converts the chain-free mode from conjecture to evidence and is the only path to H5 being 'completion' rather than a re-ranker. (3) An intra-rater reliability estimate (mined supersedes re-grades + ~20 blind re-grades) showing the label noise ceiling is compatible with AUC ≥0.65 — making both pass and kill branches interpretable. (4) At 150-200 labels with new-cohort holdout quarantine, the full model beating max_hop-only by ≥+0.05 within-topic with paired-permutation p<0.05 — beating the verified single feature, not the dead cascade baseline, is the bar that matters. (5) A candidate-universe design (e.g. kNN-based, not shared-cluster) demonstrated to include zero-property vehicles, so the precomputed serving claim covers the live-signal region. Any two of (1)-(4) would move me to 'survives'; conversely, the chain-free leap nulling AND no new family clearing its gate would move me to kill, leaving only the path-geometry re-ranker H5 admits it collapses into.
refutation.salvage: Substantial, which is why this is wounded not killed. (1) The WRAPPER is right even though the basket is wrong: a small supervised scorer trained at HQ and shipped as precomputed SQLite is the correct distillation target for the LLM-judge labels once they scale — keep H5 as the SERVING/distillation layer of the judge hypothesis, not as a rival signal source. (2) extract_pair_features_v2.py behind the existing 34-test harness is worth building, but re-scoped: within-topic primary metric, single-family pre-registered probes first (domain-pair contingency with topic-marginal null is the cheapest untested probe in the whole programme and should run standalone, this week, before any omnibus model), missingness-only null, holdout quarantine. (3) The schema/provenance items are hypothesis-independent and belong on the shared roadmap regardless of H5's fate: materialise the 90 verdicts into v2-aligned metaphor_bridges/judgments with a tags child table, persist max_hop_cos/std_hop_cos/n_hops and per-step phrase/head, define chain_signature↔path_hash (strip proposer), stop discarding paid proxy-judge weak labels, add the synsets(domainid) index, canonicalise the 746/876/2386 corpus triplication. (4) The one-time synset_knn build (~50MB, minutes of BLAS) is cheap, reusable by ANY hypothesis needing chain-free geometry, and doubles as the hubness audit instrument. (5) The pedagogical-explainability observation (leap size, rarity, domain jump as student-facing explanations) is a real product asset that survives even if only max_hop_cos remains standing — it attaches to whatever feature set wins. (6) The honest collapse mode H5 itself names — chain-dependent re-ranker over Sonnet-generated candidates scored primarily by path geometry — is independently supported (MERMAID shape, max_hop 0.667/0.767, generation $0.25/topic) and is probably the actual near-term product; salvage it as its own hypothesis rather than as H5's failure state.
